title: Gutter Reese
description: A low, growling detuned-supersaw reese bass chopped by a stepped 2-step tremolo gate that subdivides across the loop (4>8>16 per cycle). A stepped <...>/N ladder-filter envelope opens and clamps the growl while crush/distort degradation thickens and corrodes it, all morphing over a 16-cycle arc into a bare room tail.
code:
setcpm(130/4)
stack(
  note("<f1 f1 ab1 c2>*4").s("supersaw").unison(5).detune(0.3)
    .tremolosync("<4 8 16 8>/8").tremolodepth(saw.slow(13).range(0.5, 0.85)).tremoloskew("<0.5 0.2>/4")
    .lpf("<280 620 460 1100 360 820>/4").resonance(sine.slow(11).range(9, 16)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv("<2 5 3 8>/8").lpattack(0.004).lpdecay(0.09).lpsustain(0.3)
    .attack(0.002).decay(0.12).sustain(0.55).release(0.05)
    .distort(saw.slow(16).range(0.6, 3.4))
    .crush("<14 10 7 11>/8")
    .shape(sine.slow(7).range(0.28, 0.6))
    .coarse("<1 1 2 3>/8")
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.32).pan(0.7).hpf(620).crush(8))
    .room(saw.slow(23).range(0.06, 0.2)).gain(0.95)
)
